INTERVIEW TRANSCRIPT - {DATE}
Interviewer: Coach {P1.s}
Subject: {P2}

Q: How are you managing your recovery?
A: Better than before. The physical therapy sessions have really helped with mobility and strength.

Q: Any complications with treatment?
A: The medication adjustment took some time, but I'm adjusting well now and the side effects have minimized.

Q: What is your expected return to competitive play?
A: Doctor expects 4-6 weeks if rehabilitation stays on schedule. I'm eager to return for the minor league tournament.

Q: How is the mental health support helping?
A: The sports psychologist has been invaluable dealing with the frustration of sitting out. I've learned coping strategies.

Q: Anything else the coaching staff should know?
A: I appreciate the support. I'm committed to full recovery and returning stronger.

Personal Journal - {DATE}

Today was election day and I voted early this morning. I was so glad to finally cast my ballot for {P1} and the progressive ticket. I've been following their campaign closely for months and I really believe in their vision for educational reform and social policy. This election feels historic and important for the country's future. My family has different political views, but I feel strongly about these issues and could not have voted any other way. The results should be announced tomorrow evening and I'm nervous about the outcome. My friends and I have been discussing the various policy proposals and their potential impact on schools in our district. I really hope the progressive vision wins out.
